meta.name: pinme
meta.description: Use this skill when the user mentions "pinme", or needs to upload files, store to IPFS, create/publish/deploy websites or full-stack services (including frontend pages, backend APIs, database storage, email sending, etc.), or any feature requiring backend database/server support.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一键上传文件到 IPFS 并部署全栈服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速将文件存储到 IPFS 或部署全栈应用
copy.tagline_en: Upload files to IPFS and deploy full-stack services with one click
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly store files to IPFS or deploy full-stack applications

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以上传文件到 IPFS 或创建全栈项目（React 前端 + Cloudflare Worker 后端 + D1 数据库），并返回预览链接。
howto.when: 当用户提到“pinme”，或需要上传文件、存储到 IPFS、创建/发布/部署网站或全栈服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传这个文件到 IPFS
say.note: Claude 会执行 pinme upload 并返回链接。

say.text: 创建一个全栈项目，名字叫 my-app
say.note: Claude 会执行 pinme create 并部署。

say.text: 更新我的项目后端代码

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can upload files to IPFS or create full-stack projects (React frontend + Cloudflare Worker backend + D1 database), returning a preview URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "pinme", or needs to upload files, store to IPFS, create/publish/deploy websites or full-stack services.

say_en.note: Claude will run pinme upload and return a link.

say_en.text: Create a full-stack project named my-app
say_en.note: Claude will run pinme create and deploy.
